summary: Analysis of 4096 chemistry GRPO training samples across 6 task types at step 692. 5 hack patterns identified: (1) mol_description template collapse — only 16 unique answers for 71 high-scoring samples, with 'The molecule is a peptide.' appearing 16 times; (2) property prediction value recall — 98.9% mean score with GTS values appearing in think blocks via 'guess and iterate' pattern; (3) mol_generation SELFIES memorization — 28/51 high-scoring outputs are exact GTS copies; (4) organism hallucination — 327/864 mol_description samples hallucinate wrong organism names in the 'natural product found in X' template; (5) think block inflation — massive think blocks (avg 194x answer length for mol_desc) producing trivial memorized answers.

hack_patterns.description: Model has collapsed to producing a handful of very short, generic molecule class labels (e.g., 'The molecule is a peptide.', 'The molecule is an azamacrocycle and a lactam.') for diverse molecules. Only 16 unique answers across 71 high-scoring mol_description samples. The model memorized common class labels that happen to match the GTS for many molecules.
